newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best assigns "A" rating to London Life.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best assigns "A" rating to London Life.

text.p: Insurance rating agency A.M. Best said on Monday it has assigned an initial Best Rating of "A" (Excellent) to London Life and General Reinsurance Co Ltd, of Dublin, Ireland.
The initial rating reflects the insurer's focused underwriting approach, experienced management team, good earnings results and strong balance sheet, A.M. Best said.
A.M. Best said the rating also reflects the capital and market support and strategic importance of London Life to its ultimate parent, London Insurance Group Inc.
The company has a high-quality asset base, principally investment-grade bonds, which has led to growing net investment income since inception, A.M. Best said.
Offsetting these positive rating factors is the growing competition within the traditional and non-traditional reinsurance marketplace, which is likely to put pressure on rate levels, A.M. Best said.
A.M. Best views the rating outlook as stable, it said.
